text: Hey, I’ve been considering applying to graduate school. What do you think? I think it’s a great idea! I could definitely see it being a good fit for you. Yeah, but I still don’t know exactly what I want to do for my career. Well, even if you’re not sure what you want to do right away, a graduate degree can provide a lot of opportunities. You should definitely think about your career path before choosing a program, though. Do you know what opportunities you can get with a graduate degree in creative writing? Are you considering creative writing? Cool! You’d have a lot of career options afterwards, like becoming an author, an editor, or working in publishing. Yeah, that’s true, but I feel like I may need a break before going back to school again. That’s totally understandable. There’s no rush. You can always take some time off and then decide later if you want to go to graduate school or not. Yeah, that’s true, too. Alright, I’ll sign up for the class then! Thanks for the advice!
